# test_component_surface.txt's program on android, under Robolectric, less its
# click: that needs the test's model mounted as content, which the agent
# runner does not do yet.
#
# The Kotlin test lowerer rendered anything it had no special case for through
# a translator over an empty package, so none of MainScreenState's members
# were known to it: a computed read as `c.zero()` against a `val`, a
# component method's receiver was passed as its first argument, an enum
# member was a bare `off`, package state and funcs were bare names, and
# `c.ps[1].a` was taken for a node's text. It now renders through the
# package, spelling each state member as MainScreen does but through the
# instance the test holds, and writes by the ordinary translator on the UI
# thread.
#
# And a computed was a `derivedStateOf` in the state class: read once by a
# test outside any composition and then invalidated by a write, it left
# Compose never idle, and every later waitForIdle in the session timed out
# after a minute. It is a getter there now.


sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric app.sngl
stdout '11 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

struct Inner {
    v int
}

struct P {
    a int
    b string
    inner Inner
}

enum Mode {
    off
    on
}

unit tick { tk }

var total = 10

func describe() string {
    return "total {total}"
}

component comp node {
    var n = 1
    var f = 1.5
    var s = "hi"
    var on = false
    var xs = [1, 2, 3]
    var mp map<string, int> = {"a" = 1, "b" = 2}
    var ps list<P> = [{a = 1, b = "x", inner = {v = 5}}, {a = 2, b = "y", inner = {v = 6}}]
    var p P = {a = 3, b = "z", inner = {v = 7}}
    var mode = Mode.off
    var t tick = 3tk
    var o option<int> = null
    func zero() int {
        return n + 1
    }
    func add(k int) int {
        return n + k
    }
    func bump() {
        n = n + 1
    }
    vbox {
        text(value = string(n))
        button #inc(text = "inc", @click { n = n + 1 })
    }
}

func testScalars(t Test, c comp) {
    t.assert(c.n == 1)
    t.assert(c.f == 1.5)
    t.assert(c.s == "hi")
    t.assert(!c.on)
    t.assert(c.s.length() == 2)
}

func testScalarWrites(t Test, c comp) {
    c.n = 4
    c.s = "yo"
    c.on = true
    c.f = 2.5
    t.assert(c.n == 4)
    t.assert(c.s == "yo")
    t.assert(c.on)
    t.assert(c.f == 2.5)
}

func testListReads(t Test, c comp) {
    t.assert(c.xs.length() == 3)
    t.assert(c.xs[1] == 2)
    t.assert(c.xs.contains(3))
    t.assert(c.xs.indexOf(2) == 1)
    t.assert(c.xs.join(",") == "1,2,3")
    t.assert(c.xs.filter(func(x int) => x > 1).length() == 2)
    t.assert(c.xs.map(func(x int) => x * 2)[2] == 6)
}

func testListWrites(t Test, c comp) {
    c.xs[0] = 7
    t.assert(c.xs[0] == 7)
    c.xs.push(4)
    t.assert(c.xs.length() == 4)
    c.xs = [9, 8]
    t.assert(c.xs.length() == 2)
    t.assert(c.xs[1] == 8)
}

func testMaps(t Test, c comp) {
    t.assert(c.mp.length() == 2)
    t.assert(c.mp.contains("a"))
    t.assert(c.mp.get("b", 0) == 2)
    t.assert(c.mp.get("z", 9) == 9)
    t.assert(c.mp["a"] == 1)
    c.mp["c"] = 3
    t.assert(c.mp.length() == 3)
}

func testStructs(t Test, c comp) {
    t.assert(c.ps[1].a == 2)
    t.assert(c.ps[0].b == "x")
    t.assert(c.ps[1].inner.v == 6)
    t.assert(c.p.inner.v == 7)
    c.p.a = 9
    t.assert(c.p.a == 9)
    c.ps[0].a = 11
    t.assert(c.ps[0].a == 11)
}

func testMethods(t Test, c comp) {
    t.assert(c.zero() == 2)
    t.assert(c.add(5) == 6)
    c.bump()
    t.assert(c.n == 2)
}

func testEnumUnitOption(t Test, c comp) {
    t.assert(c.mode == Mode.off)
    c.mode = Mode.on
    t.assert(c.mode == Mode.on)
    t.assert(int(c.t) == 3)
    t.assert(c.o == null)
    c.o = 4
    t.assert(c.o != null)
}


func testPackageFunc(t Test, c comp) {
    t.assert(describe() == "total 10")
    t.assert(total == 10)
    total = 11
    t.assert(describe() == "total 11")
}

func testPackageFuncAlone(t Test) {
    t.assert(describe() == "total 10")
}

func testLocals(t Test, c comp) {
    var ys = c.xs
    t.assert(ys.length() == 3)
    var sum = 0
    for var x = c.xs {
        sum = sum + x
    }
    t.assert(sum == 6)
}

window {
    comp
}
